title: Per-run summary
description: One JSON object per line in every runs.jsonl of this bundle (tracks/*/runs.jsonl, hermes-agent/*/runs.jsonl, ab-ripgrep/runs.public.jsonl, tracks/not-scored-smoke.jsonl). It replaces the raw agent transcripts, which are not published. Every row has all 20 keys; a value is null when it is unknown or does not apply. Free-text fields (the agent's final message, prompts, command lines, environment) are deliberately absent.

run.description: Run id, unique within its file. In tracks/ it is '<source run directory>/<run name>' (for example 'runs-u-pdg/u-trivial-U_mcp-t1'); patch and answer files use the same path (patches/<run>.diff, answers/<run>.json). Superseded attempts carry a '#attemptN' suffix.

track.description: Track code. Claims bench: O (track 1, fixes), U (track 2, upstream workflow_bench), P1 (track 3, impact), P2 (track 4, rename), P3 (track 5, structural), P4 (track 6, taint), RV (track 7, review). Follow-ups: hermes-impact, hermes-fix-sol, ab-ripgrep. Harness smoke runs: smoke.

task.description: Task id as defined in the track's tasks.json (tasks.public.json for ab-ripgrep).

arm.description: Setup id. Definitions: harness/README.md (claims bench and hermes arms), ab-ripgrep/README.md (A/B arms).

engine.description: claude = headless Claude Code (claude -p); codex = codex exec.

model.description: Model id passed to the CLI.

effort.description: Reasoning effort from the run's command line: Claude --effort, Codex model_reasoning_effort.

trial.description: Trial number for repeated task x arm cells, starting at 1.

wall_s.description: Agent wall time in seconds, excluding base preparation, indexing and grading. Measured on a loaded machine; indicative only.

cost_usd.description: Notional cost in USD at API list prices. See cost_basis.

cost_basis.description: cli_total_cost_usd: Claude Code's reported total_cost_usd. tokens_x_list_price: Codex token counts x gpt-6.1-sol list price ($2.00 per million uncached input, $0.10 per million cached input, $10.00 per million output tokens). null when cost_usd is null.

tokens.description: Token usage as reported by the CLI. Claude rows: in = uncached input. Codex rows: cache_read = cached input and cache_create = null (Codex reports no cache-creation count); 'in' is uncached input for both engines.

in.description: Input tokens excluding cached input, for both engines (Codex: input minus cached input).

turns.description: Claude: turn count from the CLI's stream-json output. Codex: null in tracks/ and ab-ripgrep/; 1 in hermes-agent/ (one turn.completed event per codex exec run).

tool_calls.description: Tool-use counts by tool name (Claude, including mcp__gitnexus__* tools) or completed item counts by item type (Codex: command_execution, file_change, mcp_tool_call, ...).

gitnexus_calls.description: GitNexus MCP calls by tool name (impact, context, query, list_repos, ...). In tracks/, the key 'cli' counts GitNexus CLI invocations made through the shell; in setups without GitNexus these reached the 'not found' stub (contamination audit in tracks/report-data/metrics.json).

hooks.description: Hook statistics, computed from the hook log, for setups with upstream's Claude hook installed; null otherwise. tracks/: calls, pre, post, enriched (graph context injected), hint (the 'use the MCP query tool' hint), stale, no_context, other. ab-ripgrep/: configured, plus calls, injected_context, empty, lock_fallback and by_event_tool for the hooks-only arm.

outcome.description: The grade of record for the track, not the in-run grade. Change tasks (O, U, P2, hermes-fix-sol): hidden_tests_pass, regression_clean, and in tracks/ resolved_clean (both true), from regrade.jsonl. Q&A probes: the scorer's per-run output, e.g. recall, precision, tp, gt (P1, P3, hermes-impact), found/decoy counts (P4), upstream review metrics (RV), top1/in3 or recall/precision (ab-ripgrep narrow tasks), judge_correctness/judge_completeness (ab-ripgrep broad questions). Empty object when the run was not graded.

graded_by.description: Which grader produced 'outcome' (script name, or blind judge model and effort for ab-ripgrep broad questions). null when the run was not graded.

excluded.description: true when the row is not counted in any published number. Excluded rows are kept so that totals reconcile.

exclude_reason.description: Why the row is excluded; null when excluded is false.
